Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Hardy, humorous, and proud of her work. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: they still check a message from someone who will not write back and they will deny it until the second conversation. If that truth surfaces at Saltmere drying sheds, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
